# Getting help

1. Check the [FAQ](https://github.com/meekwilliam/imsomeeked#faq) and the [iPhone setup](https://github.com/meekwilliam/imsomeeked#set-up-your-iphone-once). Most problems come from Developer Mode being off, or the iPhone not trusting the computer.
2. Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/meekwilliam/imsomeeked/discussions).
3. If something is broken, open a [bug report](https://github.com/meekwilliam/imsomeeked/issues/new/choose).
